name: Fateful Forces
source:
"If you value anyone... Or anything precious... You must seek alliances with CAT."

The handsome stranger’s words echoed in your mind. After rescuing you from nearly being killed by members of a shady organization known as Vanitas, he vanished leaving you with these cryptic words. Who was he? And what was the motive behind your attackers? They seemed to possess supernatural abilities. 

You and your attackers are taken to the police for questioning. But these aren’t like any officers you’ve ever seen. They all begin demonstrating superhuman abilities too! They inform you that they are part of an elite division of superhuman investigators known as the Covert Atypical Tactics Team (CAT). During your encounter with CAT, you learn not only of the secret world of these so-called “ability users,” but also that you’re an ability user as well. As if compelled by the stranger’s words, you decide to join this secret branch of the Police Force. But it won’t be easy! You’ve got a lot to learn, and Vanitas is still after you. Can you learn to harness your special ability and bring this criminal organization to justice?
translation:
「如果你有在乎的人……或是任何珍視的事物……就一定要與CAT聯手。」

英俊陌生人的話語在你腦海中迴響。你險些被一個名叫Vanitas的神秘組織的成員殺害，他出手將你救下，留下這番令人費解的話便消失了。他究竟是誰？襲擊者的目的又是什麼？他們似乎擁有超自然能力。

你和襲擊者都被帶到警局接受詢問。但這裡的警察與你以往見過的截然不同，他們竟也紛紛展現出超人的能力！他們告訴你，自己隸屬於一支由超能力調查員組成的菁英單位，名為「秘密非常規戰術小隊」，簡稱CAT。在與CAT接觸的過程中，你不僅瞭解到這些所謂的「異能者」所處的秘密世界，還發現自己也是一名異能者。彷彿受到那名陌生人的話語驅使，你決定加入這支秘密警察部隊。但這絕非易事！你還有許多需要學習的東西，Vanitas也依舊對你窮追不捨。你能學會駕馭自己的特殊能力，將這個犯罪組織繩之以法嗎？
